ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md §4.1 mandates that exact suffix, 'exactly the shipped _detmath shape', for ANY shared, inline-consumed kernel composition module, regardless of whether its contents are original or vendored — so the filename alone cannot distinguish the two. This registry is the discriminator: a *.bundle.mjs file is either covered by data/credits-registry.json (genuinely vendored) or listed here with a written reason (genuinely original, authored in-house). A file matching neither is failed by the gate. Every entry carries a mandatory `reason`; an entry without one fails the gate on that ground alone. Keys are repo-relative paths with forward slashes — in this repo the site-authored bundles arrive mirrored at their hub/vendored/ocg/kernels/ paths via the pinned OCG mirror (scripts/vendor.config.json), byte-identical to the site-repo originals listed in the site repo's own allowlist. `_README` is inert — it names no bundle path, so it shields nothing.
